# [TFQ-1316] Backlog is bounded exactly when the net repair rate covers generation; unit-gain repair never bounds it

## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

In the QCV-Q1 model with q0 >= 0, the backlog is bounded iff lam <= (1-g)*mu; for g >= 1 and lam > 0 no mu >= 0 bounds it; for g < 1 and mu = kappa*r, with kappa > 0, it is bounded iff r >= lam/((1-g)*kappa); with r = 0 and lam > 0 it equals q0 + t*lam.

### Governing Obligation
A statement inside the declared model; it does not say any code has g < 1 or that any supply r is available.

### Witness Audit
backlog_bounded_iff is an iff over the rationals with hypothesis 0 <= q0; the other three are direct corollaries stated with their own hypotheses. Axioms of the cited declarations: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.
